=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:41 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The review-editor transfer allowlist permits changes to the host-executed `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py`.
  WHY: An editor can transfer modified hook code to the host runner, weakening or bypassing the merged-PR commit/push guard.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:1098 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The test asserts that the host-executed safety hook is allowed by the review-editor transfer allowlist.
  WHY: It enforces the insecure transfer behavior instead of asserting that the safety hook is excluded.
- .github/ai/claude_engine.json:49-98 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: All nine Phase 5c role defaults are set to `"engine": "codex"` rather than `"engine": "claude"`.
  WHY: These roles resolve to Codex by default, preventing the Phase 5c cut-over and making `CLAUDE_FIXER_ENABLED` ineffective.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:121-125 and 148-155 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The LAST RUN DIFF fixes target a `poller_claude_judge` function that is absent from HEAD.
  WHY: The function and its related machinery were removed in the merge, so the targeted fixes and Claude judge path are inoperative.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:64-65 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The `poller_claude_judge` function and all five judge call-site wrappers are absent.
  WHY: Every orchestrator judge bypasses the Claude wrapper and runs its legacy Codex command directly.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:204 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The poller workflow lacks the “Resolve AI engine” step and its issue listing omits tracking-issue labels.
  WHY: Label-driven Claude preflight cannot run for projects carrying `ai:engine-claude`.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
